# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **GPU correctness and text shaping**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 development improves GPU rendering correctness and updates HarfBuzzSharp to HarfBuzz 15.0.0. The unreleased changes correct reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection, improve affected Vulkan device-loss cleanup, and bound Graphite clip recording. HarfBuzzSharp also gains 30 named script constants.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **More reliable hairlines and GPU text** — Corrects oversized square caps on zero-length hairlines under reflected transforms, guards against non-finite cap calculations, and rounds Ganesh text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong texture for ordinary and LCD text. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Targeted Vulkan device-loss workaround** — Adds a 1 ms delay on affected Ganesh and Graphite device-loss cleanup paths for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42.0 up to, but not including, 56.0. Ordinary successful submissions are not delayed; affected-device behavior was not specifically verified in the integration review. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Bounded Graphite clip recording** — Flushes based on effective undrawn clip elements to keep recording within render-pass limits. A draw whose clips cannot fit even in a fresh pass is rejected and logged rather than overflowing the pass structures. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz updated to 15.0.0** — Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and aligns HarfBuzzSharp and its NativeAssets package versions at 15.0.0, while retaining the HarfBuzzSharp assembly version at 1.0.0.0. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## API Surface

- **More named HarfBuzz script values** — Adds 30 HarfBuzzSharp Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, for 179 named values matching the native script list. Existing fields, values, parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain intact. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))
